summary: The capture interpreter keeps native operations and clock immutable per original session; production prepare selects unchanged Linux calls, while friend-visible controlled construction supplies inert operations and refuses native lease duplication. Registered actual activity, original ends, bounded immutable evidence, sticky failures and close uncertainty remain with the caller owner; release retains outstanding root leases. Ten finite real-interpreter controls cover pending read, uncertain synthetic close, cancellation, failure ordering and normal lifecycle joins. These controls and hosted source qualification cannot establish blocked kernel read or physical uncertain-close acceptance. The existing physical wrapper deliberately retains unsettled sessions, so a separate qualified observation and whole-worker/resource teardown boundary is still required. C2 loader/profile/package joins and physical acceptance remain open.
title: Capture owner retention does not establish physical blocked-read or uncertain-close qualification
